package.name: ubot_worlds
package.description: Gazebo Harmonic worlds for the ubot low-cost navigation benchmark: a replica of the physical 5x5 m arena and the AWS RoboMaker small house, bookstore and small warehouse (Harmonic ports), each with condition overlays (glass, dynamic obstacles, low light), mission definitions and ground-truth occupancy maps. Run scripts/fetch_models.sh before building.
